IT Fleet Deployment & DevSecOps

Enterprise MSI, Group Policy & CI/CD Pipelines

Born in production higher-education and public-sector web compliance workflows, RaggieSoft Accessibility Studio deploys cleanly across managed Windows 11 Pro workstations (x64 & ARM64) and headless build runners.

Silent Enterprise Setup (/s) & Group Policy Properties

Deploy the universal x64 + ARM64 offline setup executable unattended through Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM), or winget with zero user prompts and deterministic Windows Registry policy defaults. 

raggiesoft-accessibility-studio-setup.exe /s ^
  COMPLIANCE_PROFILE="AdaTitleIIWeb" ^
  BATCH_THROTTLE_MS="1500" ^
  DISABLE_TELEMETRY="1" ^
  ADD_CLI_TO_PATH="1"
Public Windows Installer (MSI) & Group Policy Registry Matrix
Public MSI Property Default Value Windows Policy Registry Path Enterprise Behavior
INSTALLDIR C:\Program Files\RaggieSoft\Accessibility Studio\ HKLM\Software\RaggieSoft\AccessibilityStudio\InstallDir Target workstation installation directory for `AccessibilityStudio.exe` and headless `a11y-studio-cli.exe`.
COMPLIANCE_PROFILE Wcag22AA_Section508 HKLM\Software\Policies\RaggieSoft\AccessibilityStudio\ComplianceProfile Sets organization-wide default rule profile (`Wcag22AA_Section508`, `Wcag22LevelA`, `AdaTitleIIWeb`, or `StrictEnterpriseAll`).
BATCH_THROTTLE_MS 1500 HKLM\Software\Policies\RaggieSoft\AccessibilityStudio\BatchThrottleMs Default polite inter-request delay (`0`–`30000` ms) for authenticated portal and sitemap batch queues.
DISABLE_TELEMETRY 1 HKLM\Software\Policies\RaggieSoft\AccessibilityStudio\DisableTelemetry Enforces 100% air-gapped zero-telemetry workstation operation across regulated public-sector and enterprise fleets.
ADD_CLI_TO_PATH 1 HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment\Path Appends the CLI directory to system `PATH` so PowerShell, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps runners can invoke `a11y-studio-cli` directly.

Headless CI/CD Gatekeeper (a11y-studio-cli)

Fail pull requests automatically when new Critical or Serious WCAG 2.2 / Section 508 regressions enter a web repository, and upload SARIF 2.1.0 directly to GitHub Code Scanning or Azure DevOps. 

# Audit a compiled static site or web template tree and fail CI on Serious/Critical regressions:
a11y-studio-cli audit ./dist \
  --profile Wcag22AA_Section508 \
  --sarif ./artifacts/a11y-audit.sarif \
  --html ./artifacts/a11y-executive-report.html \
  --fail-on Serious
